note: Patches other mods make to the same code, the same way, as one of our switches. Exactly one copy may run: while the other mod's patch is active (installed, its mixin listed for this side, its option on), our switch steps aside; otherwise our switch applies and the other mod's mixin is cancelled. See bons.furious.guard.ForeignPatches. Checked against Collections Of Optimizations 4.4 (CurseForge file 9026925, sha1 d1b067885b0827c12b7eb75bc02896d270adaed8) on 2026-10-02. The Collections Of Optimizations 4.6 entries are carried from the Forge 1.0.36 release for the keys this port ships; they only act when that mod is installed, which no NeoForge 1.21.1 test of this port has. Rechecked on 2026-11-11 (1.0.49.2+mc1.21.1) against Moonrise 0.1.0-beta.15, Afterburner 0.2.6 and SuperChunk 0.6.0 / 0.6.1 next to Distant Horizons: rows for patches that cannot run together with ours next to those mods.

yields.name: Collections Of Optimizations
yields.why: Both run RenderSystem.limitDisplayFPS just before Window.updateDisplay. Called twice in a row the limiter waits a second full frame interval, so with both on every frame waits twice and a frame-rate cap is halved (vsync off).

(0/1)'): every world start with SuperChunk 0.5.0-0.6.1 and Forge 1.0.49 (reproduced there 2026-11-08; the same mixin classes are in SuperChunk for NeoForge).
